notes.title: The First BALLance Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while, huh? If you were wondering, we've been busy working on our next Anton adventure, [b]ANTONBLAST[/b].  It's a massive action platformer inspired by the Game Boy Advance, but pushing beyond what that console could ever do! Here's a look at the trailer:

[previewyoutube=GEuT3k1Y2ts;full][/previewyoutube]

ANTONBLAST will launch in 2023 on Steam. You can wishlist the game here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1887400/ANTONBLAST/]ANTONBLAST[/url]

While we've been hard at work on ANTONBLAST, we also recently reacquired the publishing rights to Antonball Deluxe. We see this as a great opportunity: Whilst Antonball Deluxe was very difficult to many players, there was definitely a lot of love for the title, and so we intend to continue to support the game and make it the absolute best we can!

We have many updates planned for the game, but for now, here's a smaller one. The biggest changes are to Anton's physics - these are all in service of making the game more fun for the player, and leaving the challenge to you! If you thought the game kicked your ass a little too hard before... try it now and you just might be surprised :}

[b]CHANGELOG[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced Anton's skid frames from 10 to 5
[*] Buffed Anton's acceleration and deceleration speeds - he is much tighter now
[*] Anton's horizontal speed is no longer nerfed while backflipping/double jumping
[*] Anton's gravity is considerably slower, meaning lighter jumps
[*] Removed most solid platforms in Boiler Sewers and replaced them with passthroughs
[*] Multiball powerups are no longer capped at a maximum of three balls
[*] Fudge Mountain ice physics are nerfed
[/list]

We'll have more news on Antonball Deluxe updates in the future. Happy balling!

Best,
Tony Grayson
Studio Head | Summitsphere

notes.title: Behold... The Double Jump!
notes.notes:
[b]THE DOUBLE JUMP IS NOW LIVE![/b]

Hello, friends!

We've added a double jump to Antonball Deluxe! Wait, what?! Yeah, really. It's here. Since launch we've received a lot of feedback from ballers all around the world, and a common thread we discovered was that the game's controls may not have been as intuitive as we'd like them to be. Based on feedback, we've decided to add a traditional double jump to the game as an additional movement mechanic! It works exactly as you'd expect: press the button to jump once, then press it again to jump once more! Simple, right?

For those of you who liked the old backflip mechanic - it's still there just as it was before. I personally find myself using the double jump and backflip for different purposes during gameplay, so experiment and figure out what suits you best.

Additionally, we've also buffed Anton's movement speed - about 1.25x! You should find it much easier to zip around levels now. Anton's clutch also moves a bit faster and lasts longer.

Lastly, we've also added arrow indicators when holding up/down in Antonball mode to show where your ball will go. This can be toggled in the options menu if you don't like it, of course.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[i]-Double Jump (default, is not togglable)
-Player speed has been buffed (about 1.25x faster)
-Arrow indicators have been added for aiming up/down (these can be toggled on/off)
-Dash lasts longer and moves faster
-Return speed of clutched balls has been nerfed[/i]

These updates are live now on Steam and will launch soon on other platforms. Happy balling!

[i]Tony Grayson
Studio Head — Summitsphere LLC[/i]

notes.notes:
[u][b]ANTONBALL DELUXE — BETTER THAN NOTHING DLC[/b][/u]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1675010/Antonball_Deluxe__Better_Than_Nothing_DLC/

When people ask us what our first DLC for Antonball Deluxe is going to be, we've always replied: Nothing! Literally Nothing! ...and BOY HOWDY, did we deliver:

In the [i]ANTONBALL DELUXE: BETTER THAN NOTHING[/i] premium update, you can now play as the mysterious and alluring Nothing, Boiler City's most invisible citizen. 

Can you beat Antonball and Punchball [i]when you can't even see yourself?[/i]

But as the name says, this is the BETTER than Nothing update!

So we went even further: this pack also includes A BRAND NEW extra world: 
[i]"Classic Ball Training"[/i] — for both the ANTONBALL and PUNCHBALL modes! 

In [i]"Classic Ball Training"[/i], players will go back in time to the era of Super-Hard bonus levels in the form of 10 newly designed stages featuring art from Antonball Classic! Requiring expert use of moves and mechanics, these levels will really bust some balls!

[list]
[*] New Character, "Nothing". Players choosing to ball as Boiler City's most invisible citizen can challenge themselves to a new super-hard invisible mode!
[*] New "CLASSIC BALL TRAINING" world added to both campaign modes, for only the most practiced and talented ballers!
[/list]

The DLC will release July 13th, 2021, at 11:00am EDT, for $4.99.

We hope you'll come on back to Boiler City to experience these new expert options! However, we can also announce today that we'll be pushing Update #4, "The DLC Preparation Patch", on the day of the DLC release. Update #4 will include lots of Quality of Life changes and bug fixes, including a fix for the Brulo 100% unlock. It will also prime your game for the DLC, should you decide to purchase it on the 13th!

Remember, the full base game is only $9.99 through July 8th, so you've still got plenty of time to get ready for Better Than Nothing!

[i]JB Long,
Studio Producer — Summitsphere[/i]

notes.title: Update #3, "Balance to the Balls", is now live!
notes.notes:
Hello once again Antonballers!

Today is June 7th, and our latest update, "Balance to the Balls", is going live. We're very excited about this one as it makes some subtle changes to the meta to be ever so slightly more fun - check out the changelog below and prepare to play with your balls in a whole new way!

That's not all, though. Antonball Deluxe Lite has just launched on Steam today as well! As mentioned in our last update, this is a free version of the game that includes a small selection of levels from each mode. If you or your friends aren't 100% sure if you're ready to start Antonballing, this is a great place to start! It features all of the physics changes denoted below, so you can be sure that it's a perfect practice ground. You can download Antonball Deluxe Lite here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1598350/Antonball_Deluxe_Lite/]link[/url]

Lastly, we recently released Antonball Deluxe: The Ballbustin' Soundtrack on Steam! This soundtrack collection features 39 tracks from the game, newly mixed and mastered for this release. The music included ranges from the pieces you know and love with unused parts to demo tracks previously never heard before, all at the low, low price of $6.99. We wanted this to be the definitive way to listen to the music of Antonball Deluxe, and I think we achieved that goal. You can get Antonball Deluxe: The Ballbustin' Soundtrack here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587310/Antonball_Deluxe__The_Ballbustin_Soundtrack/]link[/url]

All that being said - enjoy the update, and happy balling! We'll have some very exciting announcements coming up very soon, so be sure to follow Antonball Deluxe on Steam, as well as [url=https://twitter.com/summitsphere]Summitsphere on Twitter[/url], to learn more.

Tony Grayson
Studio Head | Summitsphere

- Anton's air control has been boosted.

notes.title: A little update on Update #3...
notes.notes:
Hello Antonballers!

This coming Monday, the team at Summitsphere will be releasing a brand new update for Antonball Deluxe. We've taken a lot of time to observe community videos and player feedback, and we've walked away with one conclusion: Antonball's hard as balls! Whilst this is intentional and a component of the game many have come to love, we've found it's not always as [i]fair[/i] as it could be - so this update is centered around bringing [u]balance[/u] to the way you play with your balls.

On the same day, we'll also be launching Antonball Deluxe Lite: a new, free collection of the earliest stages in Antonball Deluxe. If you have some friends who've wanted to play with their balls but weren't sure how to start, Antonball Deluxe Lite is just the ticket for them! Wishlist it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1598350/Antonball_Deluxe_Lite/]here[/url].

Take a look at just some of the changes we're bringing along in this patch below, and get hyped for being able to play with your balls in a whole new way this coming Monday!

We'll have lots more to share in the coming weeks, so make sure to follow Antonball Deluxe on Steam to keep posted!

Tony Grayson

notes.title: Update #1 - The Quickest Update in the West
notes.notes:
Hey ballers!

We've been hard at work polishing up Antonball Deluxe since launch and have a [i]massive[/i] update to share with you. This won't be the last one, either!

Have a look below and as always feel free to let us know if you run into other issues via our Discord or Steam forums.

Happy balling!

Tony Grayson
Studio Head | Summitsphere

[b]ANTONBALL DELUXE -- UPDATE #1
"The Quickest Update in the West"[/b]
MARCH 8TH, 2021

[b]-- Patch Notes --[/b]

- Fixed a hard crash occurring when Tri-Ball powerup activated too close to solids.
- Fixed a severe error where players would be booted to the Lobby screen when completing an Antonball bonus online.
- Fixed a severe error where VS. Antonball would cause the game's menu to misbehave after finishing a match for clients online.
- Fixed input related crashes.
- Fixed pause related crashes when trying to pause too quickly or during transitions.
- Fixed a bug where the player would become trapped in the throwing state or throwing animation when not carrying the Punchball.
- Fixed a bug where the Punchball could be shoved into the ground out of reach by moving solids.
- Fixed a bug where enemies could be pushed into the ground out of reach by moving solids.
- Fixed a bug where you could not restart a vinyl that was already playing, including the "Not Unlocked Song".
- Fixed a bug where the ball could occasionally go through the player if registering a collision with the ground and player at the same time.
- Fixed a bug where flipped-over enemies would draw the wrong sprites on rare occasions.
- Fixed issue with controllers coming unplugged/turned off disabling keyboard input or crashing the game.
- Fixed some instances of an issue where dying and completing a stage in the same frame would softlock the game.
- Fixed an issue where the ball could get stuck in infinite bounce loops in certain tight spaces.
- Fixed an issue where players could not wrap around the screen in Phase 5 of PUNCHBALL.
- Miscellaneous netplay fixes.

[b]-- Gameplay Changes --[/b]

- BOILER SEWERS received layout changes to be less restrictive to player movement and introduce solid and passthrough platforms in a smarter way.
- JAM JUNGLE in ANTONBALL received layout changes to improve pacing.
- FUDGE MOUNTAIN in ANTONBALL received collision changes to make Mole escape pipes solid and return the ball like any other barrier.
- ANTONBALL phase 13 received a specific collision change to prevent the ball escaping under the bottom left platform.
- ANTONBALL phase 23 received a complete rebalancing.
- BRICK FACTORY as a whole received some other minor rebalancing changes.
- PUNCHBALL phase 25 received a minor change to prevent a perfect loop of an enemy being out of reach that could go on for several minutes preventing progress on the last enemy.

[b]-- Minor Tweaks and Quality of Life -- [/b]
- The "GET" Indicator for Punchball now renders on the top layer, preventing other graphics obscuring it.
- Punchball Phase 8 received minor graphical changes so that enemies render above the back of the bottomless pit.
- Online lobbies now play a sound cue when someone joins the lobby.
